nodes.name: risk.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the risk level taxonomy, approval classes, trust sources, audit action/capability-type/initiator enumerations, and utility functions for comparing risk levels and generating SQL IN-list fragments for capability governance.

nodes.name: riskRank
nodes.summary: Returns the numeric rank of a risk level by its index in the RISK_LEVELS ordered array, enabling ordinal comparison between risk levels.

nodes.name: riskAtLeast
nodes.summary: Returns true if the given risk level meets or exceeds the specified threshold level, used for gating actions based on minimum risk rank.

nodes.name: sqlInList
nodes.summary: Generates a SQL IN-list string from an array of values, used to build parameterized queries filtering by allowed risk levels or audit categories.

nodes.name: tiers.ts
nodes.summary: Canonical definition of the Waggle subscription tier system (TRIAL/FREE/PRO/TEAMS/ENTERPRISE), including tier capability matrix, trial expiry logic, tier comparison utilities, and TierError for access enforcement throughout the platform.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports both data constants (TIERS, TIER_CAPABILITIES) and runtime functions/class, making it the single source of truth for tier-gating across both frontend and backend packages.

nodes.name: parseTier
nodes.summary: Parses a raw string into a valid Tier value, normalizing case and throwing if the value is not recognized.

nodes.name: isTrialExpired
nodes.summary: Determines whether a trial period has expired based on the trial start timestamp and TRIAL_DURATION_DAYS constant.

nodes.name: getEffectiveTier
nodes.summary: Returns the effective tier for a user, downgrading TRIAL to FREE if the trial has expired.

nodes.name: trialDaysRemaining
nodes.summary: Calculates the number of days remaining in a trial period, returning zero if the trial has expired or the start date is invalid.

nodes.name: TierError
nodes.summary: Custom error class thrown when a user's current tier does not satisfy the required tier for a feature, carrying the actual and required tier for error handling.

nodes.name: tierSatisfies
nodes.summary: Returns true if the actual tier meets or exceeds the required tier in the ordered TIERS hierarchy.

nodes.name: assertTierCapability
nodes.summary: Throws TierError if the actual tier does not satisfy the required tier, used for fail-fast enforcement of tier-gated features.

nodes.name: getCapabilities
nodes.summary: Returns the capability set for a given tier from the TIER_CAPABILITIES matrix.

nodes.name: hasCapability
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given tier has a specific capability, optionally comparing against a minimum numeric value for quantitative capabilities like workspace limits.

nodes.name: tool-detection.ts
nodes.summary: Defines constants for the set of supported AI tool integrations (SUPPORTED_TOOLS, LAUNCH_COHORT) and their display names, used by the AI-OS launcher and shim packages to identify and display third-party AI tools.
